channelTitle: A bowl of hot water and a towel, Grandma June's stuffy-nose fix
hook: Before decongestant sprays were on every shelf, this is what grandmothers did instead.
remedy: Leaning over a bowl of steaming hot water with a towel draped over the head is an old, simple home remedy for loosening up a stuffy, congested nose.
steps: Fill a large bowl with hot, steaming water
Drape a towel over your head and the bowl to trap the steam
Breathe in slowly through your nose for five to ten minutes
caution: Keep enough distance from the water to avoid steam burns, and don't do this with young children without close supervision.
cta: Have you tried a steam bowl for a stuffy nose, or do you have a different trick? Tell Grandma June in the comments.
